description: Web app (standalone HTML, or an SPA in React/Vue/vanilla + Vite) — merges the old web-app-spa and web-app-standalone-html plugins into one, authored via the scaffold-authoring system.

help.name: Web App
help.details: Choose one appType during init: a single, dependency-free standalone HTML file (no server, no network after load), or a Vite-powered single-page app in React, Vue, or plain vanilla TS (client-side routing-ready, no SSR). vitest + eslint are wired in for every SPA choice, regardless of framework. Replaces the old web-app-spa/web-app-standalone-html plugins — same generated output per choice, one merged plugin.

minLength.message: App name must not be empty.

maxLength.message: App name must be 100 characters or fewer.

rules.message: App name must not contain control characters.
App name must contain at least one letter or digit.

maxLength.message: Description must be 200 characters or fewer.

rules.message: Description must not contain control characters.
Description must be a single line.

questions.message: Author (optional, used for package.json and an MIT LICENSE)

maxLength.message: Author must be 150 characters or fewer.

rules.message: Author must not contain control characters.
Author must be a single line.

  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2023",

    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "strict": true,
    "noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "noEmit": true
  },

    "src/**/*.ts",
    "src/**/*.tsx",
    "vite.config.ts"
  ]
}
